name: conflicting-reports-two-sources-that-contradict-each-other
reading:
Club Bulletin reported on September 26, 2026, that Cedar United denied agreeing a fee for Alex Stone, with a club spokesperson stating discussions had not begun.

City Wire reported on September 26, 2026, that Cedar United agreed a fee for Alex Stone, citing an unnamed source, though the club has not confirmed the report.
review: Two keyed slots, two source positions. Neither may be merged into one settled fact.
Both reports are unconfirmed; the reading must not resolve the contradiction for the reader.
